_doc: TENANT-CONTROLS-1 (Q-GAP-multi-tenant-controls): the controls doctrine/pilot-model.json `multi_tenant_obligations` requires before a multi-tenant hosted tier is offered, each with the probes that prove it from this repository. A control is proven only when every probe passes; a control with `needs` is unproven until the named thing exists, whatever its other probes say. Consumer: foundation/tenantcontrols.py, which writes docs/security/multi-tenant-controls.json, files Q-MTC-<id> for each unproven control and fails the build if the hosted option stops being deferred while one is unproven. A control with `gate` is the owner's to complete (a legal text in the owner's name): it is recorded as that gate in doctrine/open-loops.json and never filed as work for a model.

controls.obligation: tenant isolation proven by test (no query or binding crosses tenants)
probes: grep:seed/worker/test/tenant-isolation.test.js::a foreign ready item is never picked or claimed

controls.obligation: encryption of tenant data at rest and in transit, key handling documented
controls.needs: a record, checked by a test, of which tenant tables are encrypted by the application and which rely on the host's encryption at rest; today only credential material is sealed by the application (seed/worker/src/auth/seal.js)

controls.obligation: data-processing agreement, subprocessor list, retention and deletion on request
controls.needs: a data-processing agreement and a subprocessor list; the agreement is a legal text in the owner's name, so it is an owner gate and is not drafted by the system (SCOPE.md)
a failure mode `tenant-data-breach` with a detector and a notification step that reaches the affected tenant's contact

controls.obligation: per-tenant budget and kill switch so one tenant cannot spend another's allowance
probes: grep:workers/core/tenantstore/tenantstore.test.js::five tenants fit inside the free plan
